proposed_variables.risk: Migration can respond to price and supply; net outflow is not automatically weak demand
Announcements are not realized jobs; workplace output is not household income
Separate apartments from all housing; do not equate permits with actual completions
National rates alone cannot identify regional differences; regulation responds to prices
Anticipation and simultaneous local changes; current facilities cannot explain historical prices
Sentiment and transactions jointly respond to prices; nearby simultaneous growth is not proof of diffusion

analysis_design.unit: district-year for long-run; district-quarter where supported
analysis_design.coverage: 2006 onward only where source definitions permit; shorter common window for sparse external series
